verdict.rationale: Together AI is an API-first platform with no GUI dependency. It documents a REST API callable from any language, server-side Python and TypeScript SDKs, and a `tg` CLI for scripted operations such as batch submission, endpoint deployment and launching fine-tuning jobs, all of which suit unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive auth setup for pipelines, the `tg` CLI being out of beta for some commands (e.g., `tg beta endpoints deploy`), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
